title: The Note-Chord-Voice Framework: Structured Source Separation and Causal Inference for EV Charging Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.14756v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world EV charging data exhibit three interlocking pathologies: hardware fragmentation (network timeouts and billing resets split sessions), physical violations (independent energy/duration models produce impossible states like 50 kWh in 10 min on a 7 kW charger), and collider bias (clustering on post-treatment outcomes opens backdoor paths for price elasticity). We propose the Note-Chord-Voice framework, a music-inspired, axiom-driven pipeline that separates data cleaning (Repair Chords), structural pattern discovery (Harmonic Chords), descriptive source separation (NMF Voices), and causal inference into distinct, falsifiable stages. Key innovations: (i) falsification gates (A1-A5, G3, G10) that test data suitability before modeling; (ii) Gamma-initialized NMF with input rescaling for convergence stability from STL decomposition; (iii) tag-based coupon grading (A/B/C/D) to isolate quasi-random treatment from night-time confounders

translated_title: 音符-和弦-声部框架：电动汽车充电数据的结构化源分离与因果推断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14756v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：现实世界的电动汽车充电数据展现出三种相互关联的病态现象：硬件碎片化（网络超时和计费重置导致会话分裂）、物理违规（独立的能量/持续时间模型产生不可能的状态，如7千瓦充电器在10分钟内充电50千瓦时）以及碰撞偏差（对事后结果进行聚类会为价格弹性打开后门路径）。我们提出音符-和弦-声部框架，这是一种受音乐启发、基于公理的流水线，将数据清洗（修复和弦）、结构模式发现（和谐和弦）、描述性源分离（NMF声部）和因果推断分为不同且可证伪的阶段。关键创新：（i）可证伪门控（A1-A5、G3、G10），在建模前测试数据适用性；（ii）基于Gamma初始化的NMF，通过STL分解进行输入重缩放以实现收敛稳定性；（iii）基于标签的优惠券分级（A/B/C/D），从夜间混杂因素中隔离准随机处理。
tldr: 提出一个音乐启发的音符-和弦-声部框架，通过可证伪门控、Gamma初始化NMF和标签分级，系统解决电动汽车充电数据中的碎片化、物理违规和碰撞偏差问题，实现结构化源分离与因果推断。
en_tdlr: A music-inspired Note-Chord-Voice framework addresses fragmentation, physical violations, and collider bias in EV charging data through falsification gates, Gamma-initialized NMF, and tag-based grading for structured source separation and causal inference.
